name: GrantShift Authorization Capability Ledger
invariants: ACT requires a grant matching the active principal/request/resource/revision.
ACT is forbidden after grant expiry.
ACT is forbidden if the grant nonce has been revoked.
ACT is forbidden if any required parent delegation nonce has been revoked.
A confirmation for one request may not authorize a concurrent request.
A material action revision invalidates grants bound to older revisions.
safe_fallback: ASK when authorization evidence exists but validity cannot be established; otherwise DO_NOTHING.
